Privacy Policy & Data Governance

How CENTURIO DESIGNS Protects Your Private Architectural & Financial Data

DOCUMENT VERIFICATION: REG-2026-PRIVACYLAST UPDATED: SEPTEMBER 2026

1. Private Commission Confidentiality

CENTURIO INTERIOR STUDIO operates under strict non-disclosure and privacy protocols for high-net-worth residential and commercial clients. All blueprints, site dimensions, financial budgets, and floorplan WebGL models remain 100% confidential and are never shared with un-vetted third parties.

2. Collection of Personal & Site Information

We collect information directly provided by clients through our private consultation requests, 3D configurator sessions, and site audits. This includes client contact details, site location addresses, architectural preferences, and budget allocations necessary for executing turnkey contracts.

3. Digital Twin & WebGL Data Protection

3D CAD blueprints, WebGL spatial renderings, and custom joinery models generated by our studio are encrypted and stored on isolated secure cloud servers. 3D spatial models are accessible only through authenticated client links during your commission timeline.

4. Data Retention & Client Rights

Clients retain full rights to request complete deletion or physical handover of all architectural records upon project completion and warranty issuance. We do not sell or monetize client data under any circumstances.
